Skeleton

☆⌃

Function

The skeleton supports the body, protects vital organs, enables movement with muscles, stores minerals, and produces blood cells in bone marrow.

Clinical Notes

  • Fractures are common after trauma.
  • Osteoporosis weakens bones and increases fracture risk.
  • Arthritis can affect joints and movement.
  • X-ray, CT, and MRI may be used for assessment.
